name: Haas & Sons Electric - Electricians
old_description: provide a full range of electrical services. From additions and remodeling, to residential lighting design, to electrical repair, we are your full-service family company offering competitive pricing and a satisfaction guarantee.
about:
Haas & Sons Electric operates from Millersville, Maryland, as a family-owned and operated electrical contracting business. The company was founded by the Haas family and has accumulated over 26 years of combined experience among its team of licensed electricians, though a specific founding year is not published.

The firm provides a full range of residential and commercial electrical services across Anne Arundel County and surrounding areas. Its scope covers electrical repairs, lighting and fixture installation, heavy-up panel upgrades and fuse-box conversions, outlet and switch work, troubleshooting and diagnostics, energy-efficiency maintenance, and specialty systems such as EV charger installation, generator hookups, landscape and security lighting, and home automation. Technicians operate from fully stocked trucks equipped with surge protectors, AFCI breakers, dimmer switches, and advanced diagnostic tools, enabling most jobs to be completed in a single visit.

Primary customers are homeowners, property managers, and small commercial clients in the Millersville, Pasadena, and greater Baltimore–Washington corridor. Concrete project examples include aluminum-wiring remediation in older homes, whole-house rewiring, subpanel and breaker-box upgrades, recessed and LED lighting retrofits, ceiling-fan and smart-device wiring, and Level 2 EV charger installations for residential garages.

The company emphasizes upfront pricing, on-time arrival, and a clean-worksite policy that includes boot covers and thorough cleanup. It holds BBB accreditation with an A+ rating, follows OSHA-compliant safety practices, and employs factory-trained, licensed electricians. Recognition includes a 2019 Pasadena Voice Readers' Choice award (#2 Best Electrical Contractor), Expertise.com "17 Best Washington DC Electricians," BuildZoom top 1% of Maryland licensed contractors, Angi Approved status, Best of Houzz (2018, 2019), and Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite (2021–2024).
